title: 第11章 万器阁第12章 震惊
content_zh:
第11章万器阁
楚风眠离开了林府，便是径直走向了林武城的坊市，进入到了一家名为“万器阁”
的商铺。
这家万器阁，可是林武城中排的上号的商铺，主卖各路兵器，排的上是前三的位置。
不过现在楚风眠选择这万器阁的原因，可不单单于此，因为楚风眠知晓，在这万器阁的背后，却是现在武胜国度，甚至是无数国度最为强大的宗门之一，天剑宗。
天剑宗，便是万年之前的庞然大物，超级势力，如今在楚风眠的记忆之中，天剑宗更是远比万年之前还要强大。
能够支撑天剑宗这等庞然大物，天剑盟麾下也有着不少商会，店铺，这万器阁便是其中之一。
楚风眠对天剑宗虽然有着无数仇怨，可是这天剑宗的炼器之道，却是极为惊人，曾经剑道之主都赞誉过。
想要寻找一把趁手佩剑，这万器阁是最好的选择。
“老夫，轩景泰，楚大管家，这是要选择一把趁手的兵器？”
万器阁的掌柜轩景泰，看到楚风眠进来，便是直言开口道。
楚风眠的名声，在这林武城中可并不小，这轩景泰，一眼便是认出来了楚风眠。
来到这万器阁的武者，可都是为了一件趁手的兵器而来，楚风眠如今双手空空，身为武者，又怎么能没有一把趁手的兵器。
“不错。”
楚风眠点了点头道，同时他的一双眼睛已经是看了这轩景泰一眼。
这轩景泰，看似只是一位平凡老者，不过楚风眠却看得出，这轩景泰行动之际，身躯丝毫没有任何一点迟缓，反而是极为完美，比起许多年轻武者都要完美的多。
他的一举一动，都好像是在积攒力量，遇到危险，便是足以随时爆发出来。
这是一种只有武道极高的境界才行。
这轩景泰，是一位不折不扣的武道强者，甚至是比起林府之中的长老，还要强大。
这万器阁的背后，可是天剑宗，这轩景泰身为万器阁的掌柜，又怎么可能跟天剑宗脱得开关系。

楚风眠打量轩景泰的时候，轩景泰的一双眼睛也是已经死死的扫视了楚风眠一遍，楚风眠看出在这轩景泰的眼神之中，都是露出了几分惊讶之意。
“来，楚大管家二楼请。”
轩景泰很快恢复过来，开口道，便是带着楚风眠，走进到了二层的一处隔间之中。
这万器阁二楼的隔间，便是专门为一些有身份的武者准备，看到这轩景泰将楚风眠带到二层，楚风眠有些诧异的看了轩景泰一眼。
以林府大管家的身份，来到二楼隔间，自然没有什么问题。
不过楚风眠，可是林武城中人人皆知的废物。
对一个废物如此礼遇，这轩景泰，看来已经是看出了什么了。
来到房间之中，轩景泰便是笑着对着楚风眠开口道。
“老夫看来要先恭喜楚大管家，大器晚成，终于是踏入淬骨境，成为一位真正武者了啊。”
轩景泰一开口便是看出了现在楚风眠的实力，楚风眠倒是不意外。
这轩景泰，可是一位武道造诣极高的武道强者，甚至可能是神海境，御风境的强者。
看出楚风眠如今实力，倒也并不意外。
轩景泰开口道：“既然已经成为武者，倒是也需要一把趁手兵器，不知道楚大管家需要一把什么兵器？”
“剑。”
楚风眠道：“一把轻剑。”
“哦？”
听到楚风眠的回答，轩景泰有些惊讶。
剑修。

Chapter 11 Wanqi Pavilion
After Chu Fengmian left the Lin Mansion, he went straight to Fangshi in Linwucheng and entered a store called "Wanqi Pavilion"
of shops.
This Wanqi Pavilion is the top-ranked shop in Linwu City. It sells all kinds of weapons and is ranked among the top three.
But the reason why Chu Fengmian chose the Ten Thousand Weapons Pavilion now is not just this, because Chu Fengmian knew that behind the Ten Thousand Weapons Pavilion was one of the most powerful sects in the Wusheng Kingdom, and even in countless countries, the Tianjian Sect.
The Tianjian Sect was a behemoth and a super power ten thousand years ago. Now in Chu Fengmian's memory, the Tianjian Sect is far more powerful than it was ten thousand years ago.
To be able to support such a behemoth as the Heavenly Sword Sect, the Heavenly Sword Alliance also has many chambers of commerce and shops, and the Wanqi Pavilion is one of them.
Although Chu Fengmian has countless grudges against the Tianjian Sect, the weapon refining skills of the Tianjian Sect are extremely amazing and have been praised by the masters of the swordsmanship in the past.
If you want to find a handy sword, Wanqi Pavilion is the best choice.
"I, Xuan Jingtai, Butler Chu, are you going to choose a weapon that is handy?"
Xuan Jingtai, the shopkeeper of Wanqi Pavilion, said bluntly when he saw Chu Fengmian coming in.
Chu Fengmian's reputation was not small in Linwucheng. Xuan Jingtai recognized Chu Fengmian at a glance.
The warriors who came to the Ten Thousand Weapons Pavilion all came for a handy weapon. Chu Fengmian's hands were empty now. As a warrior, how could he not have a handy weapon?
"Not bad."
Chu Fengmian nodded and said, at the same time, his eyes had already glanced at Xuan Jingtai.
This Xuan Jingtai seemed to be just an ordinary old man, but Chu Fengmian could see that when Xuan Jingtai moved, his body was not slow at all, but was extremely perfect, much more perfect than many young warriors.
Every move he makes seems to be accumulating strength, which can be unleashed at any time when in danger.
This is a state that only an extremely high level of martial arts can achieve.
This Xuan Jingtai is an out-and-out martial arts expert, even stronger than the elders in the Lin Mansion.
Behind the Wanqi Pavilion is the Tianjian Sect. As the shopkeeper of the Wanqi Pavilion, how can Xuan Jingtai be separated from the Tianjian Sect.
When Chu Fengmian looked at Xuan Jingtai, Xuan Jingtai's eyes had already glanced at Chu Fengmian. Chu Fengmian could see that there was a bit of surprise in Xuan Jingtai's eyes.
"Come, Butler Chu, please come to the second floor."
Xuan Jingtai quickly recovered and said, then led Chu Fengmian into a compartment on the second floor.
The compartment on the second floor of Wanqi Pavilion was specially prepared for some distinguished warriors. Seeing Xuan Jingtai bringing Chu Fengmian to the second floor, Chu Fengmian looked at Xuan Jingtai in surprise.
As the chief steward of the Lin Mansion, there was no problem in entering the second floor compartment.
But Chu Fengmian was a waste known to everyone in Linwu City.
Xuan Jingtai seemed to have noticed something by treating such a waste with such courtesy.
After arriving in the room, Xuan Jingtai smiled and said to Chu Fengmian.
"It seems that I would like to first congratulate Butler Chu. He is a late bloomer. He has finally entered the Bone Tempering Realm and become a true warrior."
Xuan Jingtai saw Chu Fengmian's current strength as soon as he opened his mouth, and Chu Fengmian was not surprised.
This Xuan Jingtai is a martial arts expert with extremely high attainments in martial arts. He may even be a strong person in the Divine Sea Realm and the Wind Control Realm.
Seeing Chu Fengmian's current strength, it's not surprising.
Xuan Jingtai said: "Since I have become a warrior, I also need a handy weapon. I wonder what kind of weapon Master Chu needs?"
"Sword."
Chu Fengmian said: "A light sword."
"Oh?"
Xuan Jingtai was a little surprised when he heard Chu Fengmian's answer.
Sword repair.
